role: independent visual reviewer; no renderer or example implementation edits
scope: Final legend revision in cell-atlas, paired-effects main/evaluation, and ten synthetic transfer cases. Annotated-inhibition is covered only by the earlier baseline audit.
methods: Opened final custom PNGs and every final benchmark PNG, not only the contact sheet.
Compared the cell-atlas and paired-effects main output with frozen baseline figures; inspected PDF renders at 96 dpi as a screen proxy for final physical size. This is not a print proof.
Checked cell PDF MediaBox and extracted all text span sizes; matched 48 exported main-dot vector diameters and fill colors against the baseline.
Used helper geometry and benchmark equality/export checks as supplementary evidence; no universal area-ratio acceptance rule.

helper_combined.semantics: Union of complete rectangular guide envelopes, not ink area. The enclosing bbox includes empty gaps and is reported separately. Available regions are not actual reserved layout bands.

independent_exported_main_dot_check.method: PDF filled circular vector paths, sorted by column and row; compare circle bounding-box diameters and RGB fills.

observations: Bottom guides now form three compact groups with clear decoding: two-column category guide, three exact-area count keys, and short thin colorbar.
The recovered footer height increases row spacing while preserving the agreed canvas and 8 pt text. The table and data marks remain visually primary.
Count keys are centered on their numeric labels; no oversized or displaced size symbols remain in the PNG or PDF render.
No overall title, subtitle, or narrative footnote is present; necessary table headers and legend meaning labels remain.
cell_atlas.limitation: The smallest positive counts remain difficult to distinguish at a 96 dpi screen rendering because the exact proportional area mapping is preserved. This review does not claim that every rare dot is individually readable at every output scale.

main_helper_combined.semantics: Union of complete rectangular guide envelopes, not ink area. The enclosing bbox includes empty gaps and is reported separately. Available regions are not actual reserved layout bands.

observations: The main guide is shorter chiefly because the marker-to-label whitespace is reduced. Its original height was already modest; this is a local spacing improvement rather than a large recovery of plotting space.
Main and evaluation cohort labels remain complete and clearly grouped with their colored points. The evaluation three-cohort guide remains within the fixed canvas.
No guide clipping, collision, or competing overall title/prose was observed; plot fields remain primary.
paired_effects.implementation_evidence_reference: examples/create/paired-effects/legend-update-review.json records source/settings/plotted-data equality and unchanged SVG data-axis primitives; these automated comparisons were supplied by the integration owner.

observations: Short categorical labels fit compact side guides; longer four- and eight-category labels use top rows without truncation. Width occupied by necessary long text is not treated as a failure by itself.
Thin colorbars retain decoding titles and ticks. Small- and large-area quantitative keys are aligned with numeric labels and do not collide.
The explicit manual placement is retained; the benchmark is not a claim that arbitrary fixed axes positions have been optimized.
The 88 by 32 mm impossible case visibly cannot hold the full guide and is correctly needs_revision. It is a diagnostic failure output, not an accepted manuscript panel.
transfer_benchmark.verification_scope: Benchmark owner checks unchanged source/specification, categorical order/coverage/fill colors, required colorbar meaning/range, quantitative values/areas, and actual SVG/PNG size-key geometry. These results supplement independent visual inspection.

generalization_assessment: The helper measures complete guide envelopes, keys, labels, and meaning text; combined occupied envelopes are reported separately from the enclosing rectangle and available regions.
Fixed typography and exact quantitative symbol scale survive compaction. Categorical symbol size and padding can be reduced independently of meaningful quantitative areas.
The bounded benchmark covers label length/count, canvas shape/size, multiple guide types, explicit placement, and an impossible case. It does not establish fit for arbitrary scientific panels.
Keep manual visual review of actual exported PNG/PDF/SVG because metadata-only size checks previously missed transform and alignment defects, now corrected.
limitations: Screen inspection at documented export sizes; no physical print proof.

The earlier baseline audit uses PDF-derived bounds, while final helper envelopes use its rendering backend. Small sub-millimetre differences between their text bounds should not be interpreted as exact typography changes.
Envelope ratios are diagnostic, not ink area or universal journal limits.
No universal color-vision or publication-quality claim.
